description.en: Finalizes the background check started by CMND_INATTER_BGLOADING, applying whatever it found once loading (see CMND_INATTER_IS_LOADING) has finished.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Finalize the Inatter check once its background load is done
CMND_INATTER_CHECK_ADD();
